subject: Board update: OKR highlights, voice, and investor-facing asks (deck v3)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board update: OKR highlights, voice, and investor-facing asks (deck v3)

Team — kicking off the final pass on the board/investor update. I attached v3 of the deck with a trimmed exec summary and a new appendix for OKR variance. Quick asks below so we can get this to Avery by EOD Thursday: 

- Jonas: please sanity-check the latency/cost slide (slide 6) against the last perf run and add a one-line footnote on methodology.
- Laura: we need a short blurb about customer data boundaries and retention for the governance slide; can you provide legal-approved wording?
- Karthik: add a single-sidebar chart for sales-led pipeline vs. PLG motions and a 1–2 sentence recommendation for investor talking points.
- Evelyn: can you confirm the QBR cadence note (slide 2) — I tentatively set next steps for April 12 prep call.

Attachments: Redwood_Board_Update_v3.pptx (pptx), OKR_Appendix_2027.xlsx (xlsx).

I aim to consolidate changes by Wednesday COB so we can do a leadership review Thursday morning. If you cannot hit those slots, flag now.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board update: OKR highlights, voice, and investor-facing asks (deck v3)

Marissa — quick pass done. I updated slide 6 and added a footnote about the perf run (30k tokens across mixed seq lengths; median latency reported). Left a comment on the appendix where we call out unit economics for embeddings. Two items for follow-up: 

1) The cost chart currently aggregates dedicated and hosted — investors will want to see a breakdown by deployment mode. I added a suggestion in the notes; if we expose that, we should adjust the x-axis.
2) On slide 9 (growth ask), I proposed a softer phrasing — "targeted sales investments" vs "expand sales team" — to avoid sounding headcount-hungry to investors.

I can join the Wed consolidation call at 3pm.

— Jonas
Director, Product Ops

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board update: OKR highlights, voice, and investor-facing asks (deck v3)

Marissa — attaching proposed legal-safe copy for the governance slide (paste below). I also flagged two bullets that are investor-sensitive and should be cleared with external counsel before sending to board email list.

Suggested copy (ready for slide): 
"Customer data is isolated per account; minimum retention policies are configurable. Redwood Inference processes customer data under contractually-defined terms and does not use customer content to train public models. For enterprise customers, we offer VPC and dedicated deployments with KMS integration."

Flagged items: 
- The line on "does not use customer content to train public models" — external counsel advised we state this as "we do not use customer content to train models without explicit customer consent." I've looped external counsel below.
- The audit timeline on slide 11 references SOC2 in 2026; we should say "SOC 2 Type II in process" instead.

Elena (external counsel), could you confirm the wording above or provide a short revision?

Laura Bennett
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@whitepeaklaw.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board update: OKR highlights, voice, and investor-facing asks (deck v3)

Laura / team — suggested tweak below to keep the statement accurate and defensible: 

"Redwood Inference does not use customer content to train public models without explicit customer consent. Customer data is isolated per account; retention policies are configurable. For enterprise customers, private deployments and KMS-based key management are available."

You can use that verbatim on the governance slide. On the SOC 2 statement: replace with "SOC 2 Type II: completion anticipated H2 2027; interim controls in place (available on request)."

If you plan to circulate to the full board email list, I recommend sending with a short cover note that invites questions but avoids technical deep-dives (save those for follow-up calls).

— Elena Morales
WhitePeak Counsel (external)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board update: OKR highlights, voice, and investor-facing asks (deck v3)

I've added a one-slide snapshot (new slide 7a) showing "PLG funnel vs. sales-led pipeline" and a 2-line recommendation for investor narration: 

- Emphasize increasing enterprise conversion rate in H1 with targeted AE support and a marketplace listing planned for Q3.
- Highlight that cost-per-acquisition for PLG trials is trending down 18% YoY — we call this out in the appendix table and on slide notes.

Attached my CSV export into the appendix tab in the OKR_Appendix_2027.xlsx. I'm neutral on the phrasing for the growth ask; Jonas' softer language reads better for the board.

Karthik
VP Revenue Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@averycap.com>

Subject: Finalize for investor send — next steps and handoff

Thanks all — great progress. Plan: 

1) Jonas, you and I will merge layout and perf notes Wednesday 5pm PDT.
2) Laura: please replace governance slide text with the Elena-approved wording.
3) Karthik: leave your appendix table; I'll reference it in the notes.
4) Evelyn: schedule leadership review Thursday 9:30am PT and book a dry-run with Samir if he is available; cc'd Samir for awareness.

Samir — if you want any small edits on voice, please flag before Friday EOB. We will send the board email Friday with the deck and a 1-paragraph cover note.

Attachments updated: Redwood_Board_Update_v3.pptx (updated after Jonas/Karthik edits).

— Marissa
Head of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
